name: Summer Camps at Bishop Hendricken High School
description_short: Bishop Hendricken High School hosts several summer sports camps (baseball, basketball, track, non-contact football) and a theatre workshop on its Warwick campus. Some are run by outside organizations, and each camp has its own registration.

warnings: This page is a school's list of several separate camps, some run by outside groups (e.g., Tape Ball Theatrics, Sprint.hurdle.soar), not a single camp. Each program has its own registration and details.
No year is given on the page. Dates (June 29–July 2) match 2026 weekdays and the page copyright runs to 2026, so this is most likely the past 2026 season. 2027 information is not yet posted.

The track coaching text (sprints, jumps, hurdles, throws; sprint.hurdle.soar@gmail.com) appears without its own heading directly under the basketball camp details. It may be a separate track program, and it is unclear whether the $175 and dates belong to basketball or track.
The only price shown is $175 for one camp, so overall price range is not recorded.
Grade range K-12 is across all camps combined: baseball grades 5-9, basketball 7-12, football K-8.
